what: a spiral round tube (radius growing 76 to 210 mm over one turn, 12 mm wall) built as 8 lofted bands, each minus a lofted bore, cut in half through the axis plane z=0 and the halves joined: must give one body
method: the script is the report's own generator (stdlib only, defaults 8 bands x 7 sections, inspect.measure dropped). Every band is a hollow tube cut at z=0 and the bands abut end to end, so the join is one connected solid. No exact volume (the loft of 7 sections only approximates the spiral's ~8.15 L half wall), so only the outcome, validity and body_count are graded
